name: Hall of Explorers
summary: Explorers gather relics and records in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. The dwarven Explorers' League studies Azeroth's past here, seeking the origins of the dwarven race.

sections.title: Headquarters of the League
sections.body: The Hall of Explorers fills a cavern in northeastern Ironforge. High Explorer Muninn Magellas directs scholars and field agents as they coordinate digs across distant lands. Relics, ancient titan machinery, and prehistoric bones return from those expeditions. At the hall's center, the Library holds historical lore, with displays open to visitors and other records kept under restriction.

faq.q: What is the Hall of Explorers used for?
faq.answer: The Hall of Explorers is the Explorers' League headquarters and museum. Scholars study reports, catalog relics from excavations, and organize digs to learn about the dwarves' origins and ancient Azeroth.
High Explorer Muninn Magellas directs the hall's expeditions, museum, and research archives.

faq.q: How does this place connect to the rest of Ironforge?
faq.answer: The Hall of Explorers lies in northeastern Ironforge. Archways link it to the Great Forge to the southwest, the Forlorn Cavern to the west, and Tinker Town to the south.

angles.text: As a dwarven adventurer, you can explore relics gathered here in the search for your people's ancient origins and their connection to the Titans.
